Git Diff Checker – Free Online Code & Text Comparison Tool

A fast, secure, browser-based Git diff comparator powered by the Monaco Editor. Compare source code, configuration files, JSON, and text side-by-side or unified with word-level highlighting and instant privacy.

Key Features

  • Dual Diff Engines: Seamlessly switch between the Monaco Diff Editor (VS Code engine) and a GitHub-style token-level diff viewer.
  • Split & Unified Views: Inspect changes side-by-side or in a traditional unified patch view.
  • Intra-Line Granularity: Pinpoint changes down to specific words or individual characters.
  • 100% Client-Side Privacy: All computations happen directly in your browser. Zero code is uploaded to any remote server.
  • Git Patch Generation: Copy or download standard .patch files ready for git apply.
  • Multi-Language Syntax Highlighting: Supports JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, JSON, Go, Rust, Java, C++, SQL, YAML, and more.

How to Compare Code Online

  1. Paste or upload your original code into the left editor.
  2. Paste or upload your modified code into the right editor.
  3. Review the automatically highlighted additions, deletions, and modifications.
  4. Toggle whitespace, case sensitivity, or granularity to refine the comparison.
  5. Export or copy the unified Git patch.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Is my code uploaded to any external server?

No. All diffing operations occur 100% client-side in your web browser. Your confidential code and documents never leave your machine.

Can I generate patches compatible with Git CLI?

Yes. The export patch button produces a standard unified diff that can be applied in your terminal using git apply <file.patch>.
